list.title: Message Acknowledgement
list.content:
Hi there,

Thank you for reaching out. We will take a look at your issue and get back to you as soon as possible.

list.title: Welcome Message
list.content:
Hi,

Thank you for choosing our hosting services.

If you need any assistance just create a support ticket anytime, we are here to help.

list.title: Issue Resolved
list.content:
The reported issue has been resolved on your account.

If you are still experiencing problems, have any further questions or need additional support, feel free to contact us.

list.title: Request Completed
list.content:
Your request has been completed.

Let us know if there is anything else we can help you with.

list.title: Request for Error Details
list.content:
Are you seeing any specific error messages?

If so, please copy and paste the full message here and it will make it much quicker for us to help you quickly find the cause of the issue and get it resolved.

list.title: Website Check
list.content:
We have checked your website and everything appears to be working correctly on our end.

Please check from your side and let us know if you still encounter any issues.

list.title: Account Suspension Warning
list.content:
Hello,

Your account is at risk of suspension due to an outstanding issue. Please take action as soon as possible to avoid service interruption.

list.title: Invoice Paid Confirmation
list.content:
Hello,

We have received your payment successfully and your invoice has been marked as paid.

Thank you!

list.title: Invoice Reminder
list.content:
Hello,

This is a friendly reminder that you have an unpaid invoice.

Please log in to your client area to complete the payment to avoid further action.

list.title: Password Reset Instructions
list.content:
Hello,

To reset your password, please click the "Forgot Password" link on the login page and follow the instructions provided.

list.title: Plan Upgrade Complete
list.content:
Hello,

Your hosting plan has been successfully upgraded. The new resources are now active on your account.

list.title: Request for Product Info
list.content:
Could you please let us know which domain name or hosting plan you are having the issue with?

This will help us to find the issue and get it solved for you much more easily.

list.title: Backup Restored
list.content:
Hello,

Your requested backup has been successfully restored. Please verify that everything is working as expected.

list.title: DNS Not Pointing
list.content:
Your domain is currently not pointing to our servers.

Please update the nameservers at your domain registrar. Note that it may take up to 24 hours for the changes to fully take effect.

list.title: Ticket Escalated
list.content:
Hello,

We have escalated your request to our senior support team. You will receive a response shortly. Thank you for your patience.

list.title: Scheduled Maintenance Notice
list.content:
Hello,

We will be performing scheduled maintenance soon that may affect your sites. Temporary service interruptions could possibly occur. Thank you for your understanding.

list.title: Domain Renewal Reminder
list.content:
Hello,

One of your domains is expiring soon, this is just a reminder to renew your domain to avoid any service interruption.
